spec.title: The proof tier after example 289's engine changes, VF-018's three tests apart: every other ignored Rust test in release, none hidden by a failure
spec.description: Runs the proof tier's command with cargo's --no-fail-fast and without the three heap tests VF-018 tracks (JBMC's timeouts, which no change here touches), as the jobs after examples 287 and 288 did. The change behind it is in the own checker (lib/src/bmc), which nearly every proof-tier test runs: in regex.rs the flags of a Pattern are formulas where they were a constant (the same formulas where they are constant), Pattern.compile(String, int) of a String that is no constant asks the solver whether it can only be a literal followed by '.*' before it stays the gap it was, and one '.*' that ends an expression no longer makes an input with a surrogate the JDK's call; Character.isLetter of an ASCII char, Logger.isLoggable below INFO, the logging levels below INFO as constants and IntStream.range are modelled where each was a gap or refused. The tests of what changed (the unit tests, claims, values, pairing, object_strings, string_literals, loops, conformance, value_parameters) pass inline.
spec.expected: exits 0: every proof-tier test but VF-018's three passes
